API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIServer Group ManagementUpdates the Server Group for the specified ID.
Updates the Server Group for the specified ID.
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/serverGroup/:groupId

Updates the Server Group for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

groupId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the Server Group.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

BODY

Defaults to false.

boolean

boolean

Defaults to false.

InconsistentConfigDetails

boolean

int64

string
name
string
REQUIRED

ApplicationServer[]
